_comment: Copy to config/inbox-accounts.json (or point BROKER_INBOX_ACCOUNTS at your file). accounts: account key -> {email, ledger, posture}, all three non-empty strings, no other keys. ledger = the seen-ledger JSONL path the worker appends to; posture = per-account triage rules appended verbatim to the worker's runtime brief. A missing default file = no accounts (every inbox spawn refuses, logged); an explicit BROKER_INBOX_ACCOUNTS that does not exist, or a malformed file, stops the broker. Each account also needs <INBOX_MCP_CONFIG_DIR>/<account>.json.

personal.posture:
#### `personal`: user@example.test

**Primary inbox. Conservative posture (would-archive-only):** log intended archives as `would-archive-*` ledger verdicts and leave the mail in the inbox. On ANY doubt, leave + surface.
